Chapter 553: Chapter 8 Galaxy Master, Run Away Quickly! (Seeking Subscriptions)_2

Chapter 553: Chapter 8 Galaxy Master, Run Away Quickly! (Seeking Subscriptions)_2

You should know that within the five Realm divisions of the Ninth Rank, the final Realm is merely the Myriad Heavy Realm.

It refers to establishing ten million Spatial Layers.

But now, to pass through the third layer of the Black Tower, one must establish tens of millions and even nearly one hundred million Spatial Layers?

“No wonder it’s said that only special beings within the Ninth Rank have a hope of passing this layer,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Although the Myriad Heavy Realm is the last stage of the Ninth Rank, it doesn’t mean that the Myriad Heavy Realm is the strongest.

Theoretically, after establishing ten million Spatial Layers, one can still continue to establish more Spatial Layers.

...

But this is too difficult; every Ninth Rank powerhouse who has established ten million Spatial Layers has spent countless years and energy to reach this step, and now to ask them to continue expanding?

The reason why the Myriad Heavy Realm is set as the last Realm of the Ninth Rank is because once the count of Spatial Layers reaches ten million, one can attempt to break into the Tenth Rank.

“I am still very far from reaching the Myriad Heavy Realm.”

After pondering for a while, Lin Yuan directly exited the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

…

Outside the Nine Floors Dark Tower.

The Stone Statue Shen Ji silently observed Lin Yuan’s movements.

“Having covered one percent of the journey, the occupation of Spatial Layers is almost close to ninety thousand…” Stone Statue Shen Ji thought to himself.

“He’s just stepped into the Ninth Rank not long ago, and he has already occupied nearly ninety thousand Spatial Layers?”

Stone Statue Shen Ji did not know what to say, as he had never seen such a thing before.

He had heard of those Multi-Spatial Life forms that control numerous Spatial Layers right from birth, but like Lin Yuan, who went from weak to strong, step by step cultivating himself at such an unbelievable speed to occupy ninety thousand Spatial Layers…

“No matter how monstrous he is, passing the third layer will not be easy; it’s a test specifically set by the master back then.”

“Either step into the Tenth Rank honestly and then come back or deeply cultivate the Ninth Rank domain, the latter being much harder than the former.”

Stone Statue Shen Ji thought silently.

…..

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes.

“It seems there is no hope of passing the third layer anytime soon.”

Lin Yuan sighed to himself.

In the five years of traversing the periphery of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, Lin Yuan’s count of Spatial Layers had surged from forty-three thousand to eighty-seven thousand.

This rate of progress can only be described as terrifying, but the gap to tens of millions and nearly one hundred million Spatial Layers… at least Lin Yuan saw no short-term solution.

“These five years… I can feel that I’m about to grasp the Rule of Time…” Lin Yuan thought internally.

Five years ago, Lin Yuan already felt he was about to grasp the Rule of Time, but until now, he still hadn’t, which shows the difficulty and complexity of Time’s Rule.

Even Lin Yuan, with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, finds it challenging; other Ninth Rank Evolvers, even after spending hundreds of thousands or millions of years, also find it difficult to grasp the basics of Time’s Rule.

In a sense, the Rule of Time should at least belong to the Tenth Rank powerhouses as a foundational rule. For the Ninth Rank… it’s merely making an appearance.

Practically impossible to grasp.

“Time…”

Lin Yuan raised his right hand, and faintly, the flow of time on the surface of his hand began to distort.

This time, Lin Yuan truly felt that he was about to grasp the Rule of Time.

It could be a matter of days or perhaps months.

…

“The World-Breaking Origin Force is also accumulated to seventy-one strands,” Lin Yuan felt the quantity of World-Breaking Origin Force, pleased.

The World-Breaking Origin Force is his greatest reliance, capable of transcending dimensional planes and arriving at any world.

…

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

After five years of traveling, Lin Yuan finally entered the inner area.

“Has the aura of heaven and earth changed?”

Lin Yuan carefully sensed his surroundings.

If the outer area of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm almost had no difference from the main universe, then the inner area had an added ancient and suppressed atmosphere.

“The calling feels even stronger now.”

Lin Yuan slightly closed his eyes, starting to listen more intently.

He was now faintly able to hear what the calling was about.

“Xuan Huang… Xuan Huang… Xuan Huang… Great Xuan Huang, you have finally returned…”

The calling seemed to come from an infinite distance, ancient beyond measure, crossing time and space to reach Lin Yuan’s ears.

“Xuan Huang?” Lin Yuan frowned slightly.

“Is Xuan Huang a name?” Lin Yuan guessed internally.

The language of the calling was not any that Lin Yuan had encountered before, but miraculously, he could understand the meaning as long as he listened to it.

“Let’s continue moving forward.”

Lin Yuan pondered for a while, thus far, including Human Civilization and other Peak Clans, the understanding of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm only scratched the surface.

Even the relation between the Xuanhuang Secret Realm and other Cosmic Eras is merely conjecture, without absolute certainty.

Mainly because the Xuanhuang Secret Realm repels Tenth Rank and above powerhouses from entering, the Supreme Beings couldn’t explore, and what is known is naturally limited.

…

After entering the inner area,

Lin Yuan intentionally slowed his own pace.

“Hmm?”

“Over there?”

Lin Yuan felt something and looked in a certain direction.

There, the atmosphere was turbulent, a native life form hundreds of thousands of meters large was fighting a Different Species with a long tail.

As the two exchanged blows, the terrifying aura vibrated tens of thousands, millions of Spatial Layers.

“That Different Species has established at least a million Spatial Layers and above…” Lin Yuan observed from a distance, “That native life form is also extremely powerful, hardly weaker than the Different Species.”

“I’ll leave now.”

Lin Yuan watched for a while and then moved away from the area, heading in another direction.

He recognized the identity of that Different Species, named ‘Mo Luo’, affiliated with the Star Alliance, a rare special life form.

The relationship between the Human Civilization Grand Alliance and the Star Alliance wasn’t very good since many of the Evolution Elixirs used by human civilization are derived from numerous special life forms.
